review_scope.gait_motion_samples: 32 frames at 4 fps covering every quarter-second of the 8-second gait clip
review_scope.face_motion_samples: 32 frames at 4 fps across all 8 seconds, plus native exact closed-blink proofs at frames 82/150
review_scope.grip_motion_samples: 24 frames at 4 fps across all 6 seconds
review_scope.label_proof: Native final video frame at 2 seconds, 1920x1080

findings.technical: Connected outer seams pass all frames; full blink control reaches 1.0 in both eyes; native full-closure proofs show no exposed globe/pupil.
findings.visual: Rejected: broad circular skin/color patches, excessively protruding globes in side view and bulbous closed lids on Mark; artificial radial fur, missing fur detail and deep sockets on Lili.

findings.technical: Both characters pass native outer oral topology, seam adjacency and continuity throughout both full scenes. Existing HU visemes preserved.
findings.visual: Natural speech/coarticulation and inner mouth self-collision remain unapproved; short face reel covers only part of one utterance.

findings.technical: Hand-relative position and rotation attachment; retained hand digits and grip-driven contact corrective. Zero inside vertices in closed-star audit at three sampled grasp/hold poses.
findings.visual: Rejected: thumb opposition, fingertip shapes and rigid scarf motion need refinement. Prop/scarf visibly crosses the supporting rock during the lift/carry transition around SC003 25.25 seconds (reel 12.25 seconds). Hand-star vertex containment QA does not cover this environment collision. No demonstrated release/placement approval.

findings.technical: Final swing settles and stance anchors remain fixed; maximum stationary ankle drift 0.052 mm across 3168 frames.
findings.visual: Sampled stop/turn reaches stable support; knee compression and marching cadence remain mechanical. Numeric support does not certify full sole contact or natural gait.

findings.technical: Delayed partner reaction curves and bounded gaze added centrally, retaining existing dialogue timing.
findings.visual: Partner-oriented turn is visible, but expressive performance and response variety remain limited.

findings.technical: Existing forest retained with 420 terrain-bound leaves, three soft lights, depth of field and restrained camera arcs.
findings.visual: Forest is readable but ground detail is sparse/repetitive and lighting lacks strong cinematic separation. Full-shot continuity review is pending.

decision: Do not render the full 132-second V025 or advance feature production until the visible face/grip/acting defects are corrected. Preserve all existing completed renders and job IDs.

source_recovery.existing_v005_glb_not_substituted: Earlier TRELLIS drafts differ from the retained TRIPO characters; substituting them would violate character continuity.
